title: A New Beginning
next_chapter_hook: The golden patterns on the Tianji Record blazed suddenly, and a line of cold text appeared: The Ultimate Chess Player's next move falls upon the Imperial Capital.

text.content: The whisper pierced his soul like an ice awl, Chen Ji froze completely, as if an invisible hand had gripped his heart. "You... have finally reached this point." The voice was ancient and weary, yet carried an indescribable sense of relief. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly on the first page of the Tianji Record, and a blurry face emerged in the faint golden light. "I have waited eight hundred years for this day."

dialogue.content: "Eight hundred years?" Chen Ji suppressed the surging emotions, his voice hoarse, "How many more secrets are you hiding?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's face flickered in the golden light, and a bitter smile tugged at his lips. "What needed to be said, I have never concealed. But some truths... the timing wasn't right; speaking them would only harm you." He paused, his voice dropping lower, "You just touched the resonance of fate—do you understand what kind of Pandora's box you have opened?"

dialogue.content: "Harm me?" Chen Ji sneered, cold light flashing in his eyes, "Every step I took from being worthless to where I am today was dancing on the edge of a blade." He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record fragment hummed and trembled in his palm. "Go ahead, I'm ready to hear it."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then the golden light suddenly intensified. The Tianji Record fragment shook violently and turned to a blank page that had never appeared before. Ink marks slithered across the surface like living creatures, and ancient seal script slowly emerged: Tianji Record · Complete Version Revealed. "This is... the second page." Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled slightly, "The resonance of fate has broken through the final seal."

Chen Ji stared at the ancient seal script, his pupils constricting. He could clearly sense the Tianji Record and the demonic power within him resonating at a strange frequency—not clashing, but merging! The demonic path miasma Ye Qing had planted that day transformed into dark purple threads, intertwining with the golden light of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "The fusion of Tianji Record and demonic power was originally a forbidden art." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a weight of gravity, "But you achieved it. The cost—your Heavenly Fate consumption rate will increase by thirty percent."

"Thirty percent?" Chen Ji laughed derisively, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes, "Each time I use Tianji Record to foresee the future, it costs five points. Thirty percent is just one point five... I can calculate this much." He rotated his wrist, his tone detached. "Speak—what has this fusion brought me?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng gazed at him for a moment, and a hint of approval appeared in his eyes. "As expected of you." Golden light flickered, and the ink on the complete Tianji Record began to shift dramatically. Three distinct paths unfolded like winding rivers across the page. The first path: Break the game with power, crushing the Ultimate Chess Player with absolute force. The second path: Determine heaven through strategy, turning the Ultimate Chess Player's own moves against them. The third path: Enter the game personally, merging with heaven's way, becoming the new chess player.

choice.prompt: Three ending paths lay before him, and Chen Ji needed to make a choice. Each path meant different risks and rewards.

choices.description: Gather all strength to directly crush the Ultimate Chess Player. The highest risk, but the most direct reward—completely breaking the shackles of fate.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate consumption doubles, allies may fall
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Tianji Record · Final Form: Heavenly Fate Suppression

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the first path, a fiery light flickering in his eyes. He extended his hand, his fingertip touching the golden river, and murmured softly, "Break the game with power... I like it." No sooner had he spoken than the Tianji Record shook violently, golden light surging into his body like a tide, every limb and pore boiling.

choices.description: Reverse deduce the Ultimate Chess Player's arrangements, using their own methods against them. This path best matches Chen Ji's style, but requires spending considerable time planning.
choices.visible_cost: Requires entering the tiger's den, once exposed will face endless doom
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Tianji Record · Forbidden Form: Chessboard Deduction
choices.risk_hint: If detected by the Ultimate Chess Player, the plan will be completely exposed

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, his finger slowly tracing the second path. Dark purple demonic power seeped from his fingertip into the Tianji Record, and a blurry chessboard phantom emerged in the air. "Determine heaven through strategy..." A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth. "This is my true arena."

choices.description: Merge with the will of Heaven's Dao, transform from a chess piece into the chessboard itself. This path is the most dangerous, but also the most thorough—to completely rewrite the rules.
choices.visible_cost: May lose self-awareness, forever trapped within the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Tianji Record·Ultimate Form: Heavenly Dao Writes
choices.risk_hint: If one fails, the soul will dissipate forever

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the third path, falling into a long silence. His hand hovered in mid-air, fingertips trembling slightly. This path was too perilous, but if successful... He drew a deep breath, a flash of resolve crossing his eyes. "If the rules can be rewritten, what is this self worth?"

Just as the three paths gradually stabilized, the Tianji Record shuddered violently once more. Below the complete version, an extremely faint line of gray script slowly emerged, the strokes twisted and crooked, as if written by another person—Chen Ji had never encountered such handwriting before, yet it made his scalp prickle. "Chen Ji, do you think this is a choice?"

dialogue.content: "This handwriting..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his voice involuntarily dropping, "The Ultimate Chessmaster?"

text.content: The gray script seemed to hear his words, the strokes actually squirming slightly, writhing like a living creature as they formed new characters: "Every path, I have laid out for you. Whichever you choose, remains on my chessboard." Chen Ji felt a chill rise from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head. Eight hundred years of scheming, he thought himself the chess player—turns out... still a piece?

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chessmaster's mockery lay bare before him, and Chen Ji had to prove he was not a chess piece to be manipulated at will.

choices.description: A cold smile, openly mocking the Ultimate Chessmaster's arrogance—a chess game that can be seen by others is no longer a perfect game.
choices.visible_cost: May completely infuriate the Ultimate Chessmaster
choices.visible_reward: Force the Ultimate Chessmaster to reveal more flaws

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the vast Mental Sea. He fixed his gaze on the gray script, eyes burning with cold light: "A chess game I can see—surely you haven't already won?" His hand moved, fingertip landing on the first path: "This one, I choose. Break the game with force—smash, this chessboard of yours."

choices.description: Utterly silent, swallowing this humiliation by sheer force of will. The true killing blow is always saved for the end—remember this disgrace, and repay it twofold when the time comes.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily endure, bearing the psychological pressure
choices.visible_reward: Obtain hidden status: Sleeping on firewood and tasting gall—subsequent damage to the Ultimate Chessmaster increased by 20%

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He simply stared at the gray script, the killing intent in his eyes like deep-sea undercurrents—turbulent yet silent. He silently inscribed in his heart: The Ultimate Chessmaster... I remember. When that final day comes, I will show you what it means to "invite the enemy into the jar."

The gray script squirmed for a moment, seemingly examining Chen Ji's reaction. After a brief pause, it transformed again, forming new words: "Interesting. But your sister is in my hands—are you certain you won't save her first?" Chen Nian! Chen Ji's pupils contracted abruptly, his knuckles cracking audibly. This name was his final weakness, also the sharpest blade in the Ultimate Chessmaster's hand.

dialogue.content: "Don't act rashly." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, tinged with urgency, "The Ultimate Chessmaster's greatest skill is disturbing wisdom through emotion. Chen Nian is indeed in the Holy Sect's grasp, but if you lose your composure because of this, you fall right into his trap."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes. A moment later, he opened them again, his gaze already restored to its usual composure. "I know." His voice was low and steady, "Chen Nian is my weakness, but not my flaw." He raised his head, fixing his gaze directly on the gray script, "You want to use her to manipulate me? Very well, I'm waiting."

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chessmaster has played the Chen Nian card, and Chen Ji must decide his next move.

choices.text: Initiate the Tianji Record · Chessboard Divination
choices.description: Utilize the newly unlocked ability to peer into the Ultimate Chessmaster's layout traces. Since the opponent has revealed their hand, let's see what trump cards they truly possess.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate, and risks being detected by the opponent
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence: the direction of the Ultimate Chessmaster's next move
choices.risk_hint: Peering into the Will of Heaven carries the risk of backlash

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He poured all his consciousness into the Tianji Record. The complete version burst forth, and within the intertwined golden-purple light, a faint chessboard phantom gradually emerged. Countless points of light scattered like stars, and one shone especially bright—a silhouette of a prosperous capital. Imperial Capital.

choices.description: Utilize the Demonic Path Saintess's strategic-level ability to conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Since the Ultimate Chessmaster can monitor the Tianji Record, let's sever his eyes first.
choices.visible_cost: Need to fulfill the previous promise, deepening the bond with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Demonic Path Mist · Ultimate Style: Heavenly Blind Spot, can shield against the Ultimate Chessmaster's surveillance for one hour
choices.risk_hint: Owe Ye Qing a favor, may be leveraged later

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved the Demonic Path Jade Slip that Ye Qing had left him at their parting, injecting a thread of consciousness into it. After a moment, the jade slip grew warm, and Ye Qing's cool voice resounded in his mind: "Chen Ji? Missing me already?" His mouth twitched, getting straight to the point: "I need your Heavenly Blind Spot."

choices.description: Since the opponent has shown their cards, it means the Ultimate Chessmaster is also getting anxious. The more critical the moment, the more one must stay calm—wait for weaknesses to appear.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the first opportunity, allowing the enemy to seize a favorable position
choices.visible_reward: Obtain hidden buff: Stillness Counteracts Movement—next confrontation increases defensive and counterattack damage by 30%
choices.risk_hint: Passive waiting may cause the situation to deteriorate

text.content: Chen Ji gave no response to those gray words. He closed his eyes, letting the storm in his Mental Sea gradually calm. The Ultimate Chessmaster voluntarily revealing his cards meant he was starting to grow anxious too—this was precisely the moment the opponent would show flaws. He silently adjusted his breathing, emptying all extraneous thoughts.

In the Mental Sea, the gray words seemed to sense Chen Ji's indifference. They wriggled a few times before transforming into a barely audible sigh and slowly dissipating. "Interesting." These were its final two words. And the three paths on the complete Tianji Record now radiated a faint glow, as if waiting to be awakened. Chen Ji opened his eyes, finding himself still seated in the stone chamber of seclusion. The Tianji Record in his palm was slightly warm, and a new line of text was slowly appearing.

The golden patterns on the Tianji Record suddenly blazed, and a line of cold text appeared: The Ultimate Chessmaster's next move falls upon the Imperial Capital. Imperial Capital... that was the center of the entire world, where the Three Great Sects, the Demonic Holy Sect, and even the roots of Heaven's Dao were all rooted. Chen Ji slowly rose, pushing open the stone chamber's door. Outside was the familiar Martial Arena, the sunset dyeing the pavilions and towers of Tianqing Sect in golden crimson. Su Qingyao's figure appeared not far away, gazing at him coldly.

dialogue.content: "Three days of seclusion, and even the Inner Disciples know what you've been up to." Su Qingyao stepped closer, her phoenix eyes narrowing slightly, "Go on then, who are you scheming against?"

Chen Ji glanced at her, the corner of his mouth slightly raised. "Scheming against whom?" He chuckled lightly, pointing toward the setting sun at the horizon, "No, I was just wondering... whether the sunrise at the Imperial Capital burns redder than it does here."

text.content: Su Qingyao's pupils contracted slightly. As the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, she understood the weight of the words "Imperial Capital" better than anyone. The headquarters of the Xuanwu Sect, the leader of the Three Great Sects, was located there, and the Zhou Royal Family—Heaven's Eye's representative in the mortal world—also dominated that city. "You're going to the Imperial Capital?" Her voice was very low, "Do you even know what kind of place that is?" Chen Ji turned around, the sunset stretching his shadow long. "Of course I know." His eyes reflected the fiery horizon, his voice calm yet carrying an unmistakable edge of certainty, "That is the end point of my destiny, and the tomb of the Ultimate Chessmaster."
